lane: Q-XDIE-GEN (TOK.QW.XDIE re-run on the netlisted seam of the next die GENs)

real_rtl: compute die master qfd_d2d_static (d2d_rom of dv2f14bn; PR=1, TXDP C [6,3,1,9] compiled; slot link, CRC, LLR, calendars ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq loaded from the compiler image)
KV die master qkd_d2d_static (d2d_kv of kvs14c; TXDP K [23,4,3,3] compiled; KVN word path)
compute producer/consumer qfd_native59_dv_service (Q seat bank + Q export from the request edge (F1), FP8 K/V formatter, KVN transport, static service, record endpoint, dr_o return)

KV as-built qkd_kvs_attn (vendored kvs14c): qkd_native_attention_programme (static_ctl, STATUS encoder qkd_native_status_word (F2)), qkd_attn_cal_gen STRETCH=1, qkd_attn_service_root, qkd_attn_result_face_s (max(P0,P1,R) law, F3)
KV final join qkd_pv_fin_s (REAL fp32 add/mul: RESULT = (P0 + P1) * rz, 32-sum buffer, R join, F3)
modelled: NETLISTED seam of the next die GENs, register chains in the vehicle: compute dv2f14bi (Q-DIE14 230b28bd5; record_bundle_audit.json lane cycles = E + 1: C.tx_slot 2, C.rx_record 3, C.x3_slot 2, C.tx_record 3, C.x3_record 2) and KV kvs14q-8503e0c89 (64ce0504d gsrc of kvs14p; BUNDLE_EQ K.rx_record 11, K.tx_slot 9, K.tx_record 11); KV master NTX 3 (kvs14p bind)
outer-pin stimuli only: native59 slice Q/K/V dd_i words, compute sys_face slots (q_slot, kv_word_slot, visibility, complete), HOST context, KV layer-programme authority (go/issue/run, i_ctl)

the KV attention ARITHMETIC upstream of the final join is NOT on this vehicle: the PV pair streams P0/P1 (pbeat) and hub reciprocals rz enter qkd_pv_fin_s as stimuli on their compiled slots from kvs_attn pvfst (QK / softmax / PV tiles and ahub are TOKEN-PASS-QWEN KV single-die scope)
vehicle.no_link_codecs: no stimulus codec at either link end: the Q / CMD records are produced by native59 and consumed by the kvs_attn programme; RESULT / STATUS produced by the programme (beats from pvfin through the face) and consumed by native59; KVN by native59 x3 -> d2d_kv kvn word

checks: bit-exact Q at the KV consumer (golden qbeat), RESULT at dr_o (golden obeat = pvfin fp32 output), STATUS at the native59 rx pins == namespace {q_ready 0, done 1, fault 0, busy 0, ready 1}, KVN word at the KV end == compute x3 word (identity + generation + tag + data; the K/V values are native59 formatter output)
every frame on its compiled slot at both D2D ends (end RX/TX calendars fault otherwise), programme rx/tx_time + native59 rx/tx_time codecs (fault on any off-slot record), landing table below
no fault (ends, native59, programme, root, face, pvfin, calendar), no ready/credit wait

pair_mut_txdp_c_off1.first_match: XQ_CAUSE d2d: compute fault 1 abort 0 end_fault 1 cause 00000000 | KV fault 0 abort 0 end_fault 0 cause 00000000

pair_mut_kseam_rx_torn.what: KV seam K.rx_record torn: att_rx_v 10 stages vs rx_payload 11
pair_mut_kseam_rx_torn.first_match: XQ_CAUSE kvs_attn+pvfin cyc 815 rel 633: programme ctl local 0 record 1 (codec cause 1010) | face result_fault 0 | pvfin fault 0 | cal P0 0 P1 0 PV 0 R 0 root age 0 | ctl tx_first 1750

pair_mut_kseam_tx_torn.what: KV seam K.tx_record torn: tx_v 10 stages vs tx_payload 11
pair_mut_kseam_tx_torn.first_match: XQ_CAUSE d2d: compute fault 0 abort 0 end_fault 0 cause 00000000 | KV fault 1 abort 0 end_fault 1 cause 00000000

pair_mut_status_done.what: STATUS done bit (data bit 3) cleared at the KV producer pins, layer 4
pair_mut_status_done.fail_regex: ^XQ_ERR .*STATUS word at the compute consumer != namespace|^XQ_FAIL
pair_mut_status_done.first_match: XQ_ERR cyc 23156 layer 4 rel 2445: STATUS word at the compute consumer != namespace {0,1,0,0,1}

pair_mut_result_bit.what: RESULT beat 7 data bit 0 flipped at the KV producer pins, layer 5
pair_mut_result_bit.fail_regex: ^XQ_ERR .*RESULT beat != golden at the compute consumer|^XQ_FAIL
pair_mut_result_bit.first_match: XQ_ERR cyc 29977 layer 5 rel 2423: RESULT beat != golden at the compute consumer

pair_mut_phy_bit.what: one PHY bit flipped in a compute->KV frame, layer 3 (CRC abort)
pair_mut_phy_bit.first_match: XQ_CAUSE d2d: compute fault 0 abort 0 end_fault 0 cause 00000000 | KV fault 0 abort 1 end_fault 0 cause 00000001
